name: People.ai
description: People.ai, now Backstory, is a revenue intelligence platform that combines CRM records, account and opportunity context, engagement activity, and AI-assisted sales insights. Revenue teams use it to understand account status, deal activity, relationships, and execution risk.
agentUseSummary: Add the customer workspace's Backstory MCP-specific client ID and secret, then let selected agents search for an account through the single documented find_account tool. Relay verifies the live one-string tool schema before every call, redacts people and communication fields, bounds results, and blocks opportunity analysis, activities, contacts, news, SalesAI, forecasting, raw MCP or REST access, and mutations.

credentialRequirements.label: People.ai MCP client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the MCP-specific client ID issued by a Backstory administrator or CSM; Relay encrypts it server-side.

credentialRequirements.label: People.ai MCP client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the matching MCP-specific client secret; Relay encrypts it server-side.

capabilities.label: Find accounts
capabilities.description: Use only Backstory MCP's documented find_account tool after live schema verification and redact people and communication data from results.

allowed.label: Find People.ai accounts
allowed.description: Search for an account by a validated 2–160 character name through the pinned Backstory MCP find_account tool.

blocked.label: Change People.ai
blocked.description: CRM updates, scorecard changes, configuration, imports, exports, and every mutation are outside Relay's V1 contract.

blocked.label: Read people or communication data
blocked.description: Contacts, engaged people, emails, meetings, messages, notes, transcripts, detailed activities, and signed content URLs are blocked.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary MCP or REST access
blocked.description: Opportunity analysis, account status, news, SalesAI, situation search, forecasting, raw CRM records, arbitrary tools and arguments, and REST extraction are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Schema-verified account search runs directly. Opportunity analysis, communications, people, news, forecasts, arbitrary MCP or REST tools, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one typed account-search tool through the encrypted customer-owned Backstory MCP credential pair after live schema verification.
Railway mounts one typed account-search tool through the encrypted customer-owned Backstory MCP credential pair after live schema verification.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Backstory account, enabled MCP access, MCP-specific client ID-secret pair, representative account fixtures, permission matrix, or credential-rotation procedure is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Backstory administrator or CSM enables MCP, issues or rotates the MCP-specific credential pair, saves it through Relay Console, then verifies initialization, the exact find_account schema and bounded search, permissions, redaction, agent assignment, credential replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Backstory documents its official remote MCP endpoint, OAuth-capable clients, workspace permission enforcement, and a broad tool set spanning account and opportunity status, scorecards, activity, people, news, SalesAI, and situation search.

Backstory's n8n guide documents https://mcp.people.ai/mcp, the case-sensitive PAI-Client-Id and PAI-Client-Secret headers, MCP-specific credentials issued by an administrator or CSM, rotation guidance, and the find_account tool.

Backstory's official Gemini CLI guide confirms the hosted MCP integration, OAuth connection path, account search, recent activity and SalesAI examples, and permission-bound access that Relay narrows to account search only.
